supporting_observations.claim: At 14:13 UTC, mstsc.exe was launched on WS-LOKORO-01 by lily.okoro with the command line targeting FILE-RB-01.
WS-LOKORO-01 resolved FILE-RB-01.riverbend.local to 10.60.20.20 shortly after the mstsc launch.

At 14:16 UTC, the domain controller recorded service-ticket requests for FILE-RB-01$ from 10.60.10.24, which the supplied context identifies as WS-LOKORO-01; these records identify the workstation account, not lily.okoro.

Launching an RDP client from WS-LOKORO-01 toward a server is inconsistent with the supplied practice that server administration is performed only from WS-DSHARMA-01. The records establish the client launch and target, but not that an RDP session succeeded.
A DNS query from 10.60.20.30 for FILE-RB-01 was recorded at 13:43 UTC, near the reported alert time, but this record does not identify the client as WS-DSHARMA-01 or establish an RDP connection.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not show an RDP logon event identifying dev.sharma, a successful RDP session, or the source host for the session described in the alert.
The records shown around 13:42–13:43 UTC include a DNS query but no direct evidence tying that query to RDP.
The supplied records are incomplete excerpts, so the absence of a relevant event here does not establish that it did not occur.
claims_not_established: Whether the reported RDP session to FILE-RB-01 using dev.sharma actually succeeded.
Whether 10.60.20.30 is WS-DSHARMA-01 or another host.
Whether the later mstsc launch by lily.okoro resulted in a successful session, and whether it was authorized.
Whether either activity was malicious rather than an error or other unauthorized-but-nonmalicious action.
additional_evidence_needed: FILE-RB-01 Security logon events around 13:42 UTC, especially successful or failed RDP logons (Logon Type 10), including account and source address.
FILE-RB-01 TerminalServices RemoteConnectionManager and LocalSessionManager logs for the alert time and the later WS-LOKORO-01 activity.
Endpoint telemetry from WS-DSHARMA-01 and WS-LOKORO-01 around the relevant times, including RDP client activity and user/session attribution.
Network or DHCP/asset records mapping 10.60.20.30 at 13:43 UTC.
Any ticket or authorization records for the reported dev.sharma session and the WS-LOKORO-01 connection attempt.
